svg.text: Native-coordinate vs physical spectral-shape endpoint screen
Per-endpoint changes from frozen ROOT summaries; both panels use identical axes
Colors: factor; marker/label: model and speaker (44/52)
Both ΔCbest gains coincide with worse ΔD₀ (Ditto 44; Wav2Lip 52)
Joint screen requires ΔCbest > 0, ΔDmin ≤ 0, and ΔD₀ ≤ 0; the scatter shows only ΔD₀ and ΔCbest.
n=2 speakers (S0044, S0052) per endpoint; exploratory screen. Mouth aperture/velocity are movement descriptions, not accuracy against a ground truth.
Interpretation is limited to these frozen doses and endpoints; no inferential tests were run for this figure.
Source: frozen ROOT summary JSONs · 24 endpoints
